## Mikhbar (مِخبار)
Mikhbar is the bilingual technology publication within rdwan.dev. It covers artificial intelligence, robotics, automation, mobile, computers, software, the web, social platforms and security. Each published story has a standalone crawlable URL, source links, publication dates, structured data, and Arabic/English editions when available.

- Arabic edition: https://rdwan.dev/forum/ar/
- English edition: https://rdwan.dev/forum/en/
- About: https://rdwan.dev/forum/about/
- Author: https://rdwan.dev/forum/authors/radwan-abdulhadi/
- Editorial policy: https://rdwan.dev/forum/editorial-policy/
- Corrections policy: https://rdwan.dev/forum/corrections/
- AI and automation policy: https://rdwan.dev/forum/ai-policy/
- Forum sitemap: https://rdwan.dev/forum/sitemap.xml
- News sitemap: https://rdwan.dev/forum/news-sitemap.xml

## Technical articles
- [Building Smart File Manager with C# and WinUI 3](https://rdwan.dev/blog/smart-file-manager-csharp-winui3.html) — Batch rename previews, duplicate detection using size grouping and SHA-256, and Windows desktop structure.
- [Robotics Language Lab: a multi-language robotics learning lab](https://rdwan.dev/blog/robotics-language-lab-multi-language.html) — Control, navigation, sensors, ROS 2-style configuration, URDF, telemetry and diagnostics across multiple languages.
- [Arabic RTL UI Components](https://rdwan.dev/blog/arabic-rtl-ui-components.html) — Reusable Arabic RTL navigation, cards, forms, alerts and responsive dashboard patterns.
- [Duplicate files: size first, then SHA-256](https://rdwan.dev/notes/duplicate-files-size-then-sha256.html) — A two-stage approach to duplicate-file detection.

## Projects
- [Smart File Manager](https://rdwan.dev/projects/01-smart-file-manager.html) — A Windows file-management utility for batch renaming, previews and duplicate detection.
- [Robotics Language Lab](https://rdwan.dev/projects/02-robotics-language-lab.html) — A multi-language robotics lab for control, sensors and ROS-oriented experiments.
- [Python Toolbox](https://rdwan.dev/projects/03-python-toolbox.html) — A practical Python toolbox for files, text and lightweight automation.
- [JavaScript Lab](https://rdwan.dev/projects/04-javascript-lab.html) — A JavaScript lab for interactive UI experiments and local-storage workflows.
- [AI Tools Lab](https://rdwan.dev/projects/05-ai-tools-lab.html) — Productivity experiments around AI-assisted workflows and text processing.
- [Desktop Automation Suite](https://rdwan.dev/projects/06-desktop-automation-suite.html) — A desktop automation suite for recurring Windows tasks and keyboard-driven workflows.
- [Windows System Toolkit](https://rdwan.dev/projects/07-windows-system-toolkit.html) — A Windows toolkit for system inspection, storage visibility and safe maintenance tasks.
- [Arabic UI Components](https://rdwan.dev/projects/08-arabic-ui-components.html) — Reusable RTL interface components for Arabic websites and dashboards.
- [Student Management System](https://rdwan.dev/projects/09-student-management-system.html) — A student-management sample covering records, grades and database-backed workflows.
- [File Processing Toolkit](https://rdwan.dev/projects/10-file-processing-toolkit.html) — Utilities for inspecting, grouping, renaming and processing files.
- [IoT Sensor Dashboard](https://rdwan.dev/projects/11-iot-sensor-dashboard.html) — A dashboard for sensor readings and Internet of Things experiments.
- [Data Analysis Notebooks](https://rdwan.dev/projects/12-data-analysis-notebooks.html) — Data-analysis notebooks for exploration, statistics and visualization.
- [Web Security Lab](https://rdwan.dev/projects/13-web-security-lab.html) — A defensive web-security learning lab focused on safer development practices.
- [Mobile App Starter Kit](https://rdwan.dev/projects/14-mobile-app-starter-kit.html) — A starter kit for Android and Python/Kivy mobile application experiments.
- [C++ Algorithms Lab](https://rdwan.dev/projects/15-cpp-algorithms-lab.html) — C++ exercises for algorithms, searching, sorting and data structures.
- [Python Automation Hub](https://rdwan.dev/projects/16-python-automation-hub.html) — A hub of Python scripts for file, report and backup automation.
- [Fullstack Mini Projects](https://rdwan.dev/projects/17-fullstack-mini-projects.html) — Small full-stack projects connecting interfaces, servers and databases.
- [Developer Portfolio](https://rdwan.dev/projects/18-developer-portfolio.html) — A responsive developer portfolio experiment for presenting skills and work.
- [Portfolio](https://rdwan.dev/projects/19-portfolio.html) — A portfolio interface for presenting software and web projects.
- [RAD / Main Portfolio](https://rdwan.dev/projects/20-rad-main-portfolio.html) — The main RAD portfolio presenting identity, projects and contact links.
